auto-approve.name: Full access
auto-approve.description: Vibe tools run without Vibe's approval card, including outside the folder. Vibe Work's protected actions still need your permission.

smart-approve.name: Smart approve
smart-approve.description: A model checks each tool call: the calls it judges low-risk run, the others ask.

accept-edits.name: Accept edits
accept-edits.description: File edits run. Commands and anything outside the folder ask.

plan.name: Plan first
plan.description: Retired in Vibe 3. Saved sessions reopen in Ask; use Plan on a page to plan.
plan.tooltip: Plan first was retired in Vibe 3

vw-plan.name: Plan on a page
vw-plan.description: Plans first and writes the plan as a page in the project's handbook (docs/handbook/plans/). Other file writes are refused; shell commands still run.
vw-plan.tooltip: Use Plan on a page access mode

explore.name: Explore
explore.description: Explore the project with Vibe's configured profile.

off.name: off
off.description: Turn off the model's optional thinking.

max.name: max
max.description: Use the model's largest offered thinking budget.

vibeWork.name: Vibe Work vault
vibeWork.description: Private to this app, in its own folder, with your own password.
vibeWork.tooltip: Create a new Vibe Work vault

shellx.name: ShellX Vault
shellx.description: Open the vault you already use in ShellX.

desktop.name: Vault app
desktop.description: Open the vault you already use in the Vault app.

askEachTime.name: Ask
askEachTime.description: Ask before secret commands. Saved site and MCP server permissions keep their own scope.
askEachTime.tooltip: Ask before secret commands. Saved site and MCP server permissions keep their own scope.

allowed.name: Always
allowed.description: Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant.
allowed.tooltip: Standing permission during delegated tasks. Local sign-ins still ask each time; MCP forwarding also needs its server grant.

never.name: User only
never.description: Hidden from the agent in this project.
never.tooltip: Hidden from the agent. MCP forwarding is blocked while the default or any project is User only.

closeUserTabs.name: Close tabs you opened
closeUserTabs.description: Choose whether the agent asks before closing a tab you opened or took over.
closeUserTabs.tooltip: Ask me requests Close or Keep for each tab you opened or took over. Allow skips that question. The App preview cannot be closed.

closeAsk.name: Ask me (default)
closeAsk.description: Ask before the agent closes a tab you opened or took over.
closeAsk.tooltip: Ask you to Close or Keep each tab you opened or took over.

closeAllow.name: Allow
closeAllow.description: Let the agent close tabs you opened or took over during your task.
closeAllow.tooltip: The agent may close tabs you opened or took over during your task without asking again.

browse.name: Basic browser control
browse.description: Vibe reads pages and sees your open tabs, goes to sites, clicks, scrolls and types into text fields, never password fields.
browse.tooltip: Vibe reads pages and sees your open tabs, goes to sites, clicks, scrolls and types into text fields, never password fields.

fill.name: Advanced
fill.description: Everything in Basic, plus filling in forms without sending them, downloading files and uploading a file you picked.
fill.tooltip: Everything in Basic, plus filling in forms without sending them, downloading files and uploading a file you picked.

act.name: Full: works on your behalf
act.description: Everything in Advanced, plus sending forms and confirming (buy, book, delete), signing in with a vault login you allowed, changing cookies and site data and running page scripts.
act.tooltip: Everything in Advanced, plus sending forms and confirming (buy, book, delete), signing in with a vault login you allowed, changing cookies and site data and running page scripts.

read.name: Read pages and see your tabs

read.tooltip: Read pages, take screenshots, and see the titles and addresses of your open tabs.

navigate.name: Go to sites, click and type
navigate.description: Go to sites, open and close the tabs Vibe opened, click, scroll, press keys and type into text fields. Never password fields.
navigate.tooltip: Go to sites, open and close the tabs Vibe opened, click, scroll, press keys and type into text fields. Never password fields.

forms.name: Fill in forms and handle files
forms.description: Fill in forms without sending them, download files, and upload a file you picked.
forms.tooltip: Fill in forms without sending them, download files, and upload a file you picked.

send.name: Send forms and confirm
send.description: Send forms and confirm: buy, book, delete.
send.tooltip: Send forms and confirm: buy, book, delete.

siteData.name: Change cookies and site data

history.name: Browsing history

history.tooltip: Read and delete entries in your history.

agentResume.tooltip: Resume the agent's access to secrets. Sessions keep working.

vaultLock.name: Lock vault

vaultUnlock.name: Unlock vault

vaultUnlock.tooltip: Unlock the vault. Sessions can work again.
